section_summary.extract_value: This Design section describes a cross-sectional study using non-probabilistic convenience sampling. The sampling size was calculated based on Hair et al.'s recommendation of 5-10 participants per instrument item, with a minimum sample of 115-230 individuals determined from the IES-2 scale (23 items). The study explicitly planned to examine sex differences as sub-groups (women and men), with minimum sample size calculated separately for each gender.
